system.description:
At 1st level, you gain one PP 1 Shaman Specialist Spell of your choice.
Shaman Specialist Spells will be presented in the Grimoire and concentrate on direct dealings with spirits rather than duplicating Druid magic.
Additional Shaman Specialist Spells may be learned through the normal Specialist Spell feat and Shaman class feats.

Use to choose your PP 1 Shaman Specialist Spell from the Grimoire (Call Minor Spirit, Spirit Rebuke, Spirit Shelter, Spirit Trace, Veil Lantern); Use again to change it.
